description: The chart is a donut chart representing the win rates of different language models. There are three slices in the chart. The largest slice, representing LLaMA, occupies approximately 80.4% of the chart and is colored in light blue. The second largest slice, representing GPT-4o, is colored in dark blue and accounts for about 19.6% of the chart. The smallest slice, also representing GPT-4o, is colored in red and makes up roughly 12.0% of the chart. The center of the donut chart contains the label "Win rate (%)". There are no percentage labels inside the slices, and no legend is present. The slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way.
